theme.title: Courtside Curiosities

theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: On April 9, 2017, Russell Westbrook broke the record for triple-doubles in a season. What number did he reach?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On April 9th, Russell Westbrook broke Oscar Robertson's record for most triple-doubles in a season with 42.

questions.prompt: Boston routed Atlanta 132–99 in the 1986 East semifinals. How many points did the Hawks score in the third quarter?
questions.note: Six, as Boston won the quarter 36–6.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston outscored Atlanta 36–6 in the third quarter in route to a 132–99 victory.

funFacts.text: Before that Hawks blowout, Boston had already swept Michael Jordan's Bulls in the first round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston needed just three games to defeat the Chicago Bulls in the first round

funFacts.text: The Celtics subsequently swept Milwaukee to reach the championship round without a conference-finals loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in the conference finals, Boston swept the Milwaukee Bucks in four games

funFacts.text: That season's championship series marked the first official use of the 'NBA Finals' branding.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: this series marked the first time the "NBA Finals" branding was officially used

questions.prompt: What did 2004 Finals MVP Chauncey Billups average in points per game?
questions.context: Detroit Pistons vs Lakers · 2004 Finals · five games
questions.note: 21.0 per game for the Finals MVP, on 50.9% shooting.

funFacts.text: Billups shot better than 50% from the field and over 47% from three during the championship series.
The Lakers entered the matchup favored, with a lineup led by Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Lakers, headed by Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal, were considered the heavy favorites

funFacts.text: Richard Hamilton actually averaged slightly more points than Billups in that series, despite Billups taking Finals MVP.
